sources.title: Buyer budget discovery
sources.text: During periods of economic uncertainty, founders should validate buyer willingness to spend by asking about current budget approvals and the costs of the existing workflow.

sources.title: Sales hiring
sources.text: A structured reference call helps founders hire a first sales rep. Ask previous managers about coaching, quotas, and work habits.

sources.title: Credit conditions
sources.text: When recession fears rise, tightening credit conditions and slowing business investment can signal that companies are about to cut discretionary spending.

sources.title: Policy rates
sources.text: The central bank reviews inflation expectations and adjusts the policy rate to influence borrowing costs.

sources.title: Evaluation rubric
sources.text: Before comparing models, fix a rubric and score examples with multiple reviewers. Resolve inconsistent ratings before scaling the benchmark.

sources.title: Holdout data
sources.text: Keep a sealed holdout dataset that prompts and examples do not see. Run the final evaluation against it once the rubric is locked.

sources.title: Canary rollout
sources.text: Before a rollout, define rollback thresholds for failure rates. Send a small share of traffic to the candidate and stop if error rates rise.

sources.title: Maintenance window
sources.text: Coordinate database maintenance windows with incident responders and confirm ownership of backup restoration.
